args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (18% error rate, unhealthy in all production regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback applied to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified service health is restored: healthy=true, error_rate=0.002.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Situation:** checkout-api was deployed on v2.3.1 and became unhealthy, with an 18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc in staging was also unhealthy but never released to production).
2. Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions.
3. Verified the rollback restored health — the service is now healthy with an error rate of just 0.2%.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.
